summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of its June 9, 2026 share repurchase program, reporting 107,804 ordinary shares bought October 12-16, 2026 through a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary across XAMS, CEUX, AQEU and TQEX. Average price was EUR 26.48, total EUR 2.85 million, range EUR 26.04-26.98. Holdings now total 1,985,157 treasury shares, and the program is fully completed. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine buyback update, structurally a capital-return mechanic rather than a tender; watch for a new authorization or capital allocation signal.
